messages:
maria: heads up — PR #4521 is blocked by a CI snapshot failure on Windows integration (shard3). Need either an approval to update snapshots or a targeted rerun. build: <https://buildkite.com/redwood/flow/1234|build/1234>
ci-bot: CI failure in windows-integration (win-graph-shard3) — snapshot mismatch in components/button/Button.test.snap. See logs: <https://logs.internal/redwood/1234>|artifacts
ci-bot: failing test output:
```
- <button class="btn">Submit</button>
+ <button class="btn">Submit </button>
```
maria: the diff looks like a trailing space in the rendered label — non-functional. The change came from a whitespace trim tweak in my PR. I think updating the snapshot is fine. If folks prefer, we can try a targeted rerun first.
sanjay: if it's just trailing whitespace i'm +1 for snapshot update. can you confirm it's not flaky (non-deterministic) before updating?
maria: yep did a local run and it's deterministic for me. Also repro steps: `yarn test:ui --testNamePattern Button --updateSnapshot=false` then `node ./tools/render-snapshot.js --shard=3` — repros locally.
olivia: I'm available to approve snapshot updates but out this afternoon for meetings. If CI goes green after a rerun I'll land the snap update. Please add a PR comment so I see it in my queue.
kevin: small process note — we only have two merge-window slots left today at 11:00 and 15:00 UTC. If we need to merge now we should occupy 11:00. Otherwise queue for nightly. I'd try targeted rerun first.
maria: tried Buildkite retry but the job hit backfill limits and didn't enqueue: `error: queue full for win-graph-shard3`. @devops-oncall can you bump priority for build/1234 retry?
devops-oncall: bumped priority and forced a retry for build/1234 -> retry-2. Queued, estimated start ~3m.
ci-bot: build/1234#retry-2 started (shard3).
ci-bot: build/1234#retry-2 finished — all shards green. Artifacts: <https://buildkite.com/redwood/flow/1234#1234:artifacts>|artifacts
maria: awesome, rerun is green. I'm going to update the snapshot (`yarn test:ui -u`) and push a tiny commit with the updated snap. tagging @olivia for approval.
olivia: reviewed the snapshot diff via the PR file view, it's only the trailing space. approving now. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — merged PR and kicked off post-merge pipeline. closing thread. :tada:
